$npc.npc_corwen.line_1: The Hollow was a kiln-town once. We fired the stone that built the Gate.
$npc.npc_corwen.line_2: The shards started glowing the year the kilns went cold. Nobody here thinks that is a coincidence.
$npc.npc_corwen.line_3: Break every shard you find. They grow back, but slower each time — or so I tell myself.
$npc.npc_corwen.name: Corwen
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_breakers_at_the_gate: The Gate was built to hold something in. The breakers are working at it from our side. Stop them.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_into_the_catacombs: Below the Gate are the catacombs, nine floors down. Whatever is feeding the shards is at the bottom. Rest at the shrines on the way.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_reeds_in_the_hollow: The reed hoppers have crept right up to the wall. Thin them out before they get into the stores — east and south of the gate.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_the_gnawing_barrows: Something is chewing its way out of the barrows on the Vale Floor. Pale things. Go and count how many fewer there are when you are done.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_thornbacks_on_the_ro: The road out of the Hollow is ours again, but the thornbacks on the Approach charge anything that walks it. Make it walkable.
$npc.npc_corwen.qst_wolves_of_the_ridge: The wolves up on the Ridge have gone wrong — the shards have had them. The road to the Gate is closed until the pack is broken.
$npc.npc_hesk.line_1: Bring me iron and yang and I will make that blade worth carrying.
$npc.npc_hesk.line_2: A failed temper costs you the materials. Never the item. I do not break what people bring me.
$npc.npc_hesk.name: Hesk
$npc.npc_idra.line_1: Scrap, oil, stones, ink — always. The rest depends on what the carts bring.
$npc.npc_idra.line_2: I buy anything, at a price. Sold something by mistake? I keep it on the side for a while.
$npc.npc_idra.name: Idra
